properties_laudemio_ck.name: properties_laudemio_ck
properties_laudemio_ck.value: NOT "properties"."hasLaudemio" OR ("properties"."laudemioRate" IS NOT NULL AND "properties"."laudemioRate" > 0)

properties_rural_docs_ck.name: properties_rural_docs_ck
properties_rural_docs_ck.value: "properties"."kind" IS DISTINCT FROM 'RURAL' OR ("properties"."ccir" IS NOT NULL AND "properties"."nirf" IS NOT NULL)

property_owner_exactly_one_ck.name: property_owner_exactly_one_ck
property_owner_exactly_one_ck.value: (CASE WHEN "propertyOwners"."personId" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN "propertyOwners"."companyId" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1
